examples.en: At a village fair, I met a fortune-teller.
examples.zh: 在乡村集市上，我遇到了一位算命先生。

examples.en: I decided to visit a fortune-teller.
examples.zh: 我决定去拜访一位算命先生。

examples.en: She looked into a crystal ball.
A relation of yours is coming to see you.
examples.zh: 你的一位亲戚要来看你。

examples.en: She intends to stay for a few days.
The moment you leave this tent, you will get a surprise.
examples.zh: 你一离开这个帐篷就会大吃一惊。

examples.en: You will get a big surprise.
A woman will rush towards you.
examples.zh: 一位女士会向你冲过来。

examples.en: We must be at the station to meet her.
examples.zh: 我们必须到车站去接她。

examples.en: I followed her out of the fair.

examples.zh: 别林斯基夫人是一位算命先生。

sentences.en: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky.
sentences.zh: 在一个乡村集市上，我决定去拜访一位名叫别林斯基夫人的算命先生。

sentences.en: I went into her tent and she told me to sit down.
sentences.zh: 我走进她的帐篷，她让我坐下。

sentences.en: After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball.
sentences.zh: 我给了她一些钱后，她凝视着水晶球。

sentences.en: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
sentences.zh: 我一走出帐篷，就把别林斯基夫人的话忘得一干二净，因为我妻子急匆匆地向我走来。

sentences.en: She asked impatiently where I had been hiding.
sentences.zh: 她不耐烦地问我躲到哪里去了。

sentences.en: As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
sentences.zh: 她走开时，我跟着她离开了集市。

article.en: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky.
article.zh: 在一个乡村集市上，我决定去拜访一位名叫别林斯基夫人的算命先生。

article.en: I went into her tent and she told me to sit down.
article.zh: 我走进她的帐篷，她让我坐下。

article.en: After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball.
article.zh: 我给了她一些钱后，她凝视着水晶球。

article.en: She said: 'A relation of yours is coming to see you. She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.'
article.zh: 她说：'你的一位亲戚要来看你。她今晚到达，打算住几天。'

article.en: 'The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise. A woman you know well will rush towards you and speak to you. That is all.'
article.zh: '你一离开这个帐篷，就会大吃一惊。一位你熟识的女士会向你冲过来，跟你说话。就这些。'

article.en: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
article.zh: 我一走出帐篷，就把别林斯基夫人的话忘得一干二净，因为我妻子急匆匆地向我走来。

article.en: She asked impatiently where I had been hiding.
article.zh: 她不耐烦地问我躲到哪里去了。

article.en: She said that my sister would be here in less than an hour and that we must be at the station to meet her.
article.zh: 她说我姐姐不到一小时就到了，我们必须到车站去接她。

article.en: As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
article.zh: 她走开时，我跟着她离开了集市。
